project.title: Hybrid Workshop Layout for Construction and PCB Prep Area
project.objective: Redesign the shared workshop layout to safely handle construction prep, PCB assembly prep, and garden tool maintenance while improving efficiency and safety.
deliverables: Approved workshop zoning and layout plan
Standard operating procedures for each work zone
Implementation schedule and shift usage plan
constraints: Workshop must remain operational during changes
Compliance with safety and hazardous materials rules
Limited budget for new equipment and storage
Noise and dust must not affect PCB prep area
Layout must support both indoor and outdoor tasks

risks.risk: Construction dust and debris contaminating PCB prep area.
risks.mitigation: Introduce physical barriers, dedicated cleaning routines, and separate airflow paths in the layout.

risks.risk: Tool and material conflicts between teams causing delays.
risks.mitigation: Define shared tool booking rules, labelled storage, and a visual inventory board.

risks.risk: Safety incidents during layout changes while workshop is active.
risks.mitigation: Phase changes by zone, use clear signage, and schedule high‑risk moves during low activity hours.

risks.risk: New layout not matching real workflow, leading to rework.
risks.mitigation: Run pilot tests with temporary markings and gather feedback before finalizing layout.

risks.risk: Outdoor garden tasks interfering with material loading and crane paths.
risks.mitigation: Map traffic routes, set no‑go zones, and coordinate schedules between garden and loading activities.

themes.theme: Safe zoning between dusty construction work and clean PCB prep
themes.why_relevant: Avoids contamination and meets safety rules for different types of work.
Reduces time lost searching for tools and prevents damage to materials.
Ensures cranes and manual handling routes are efficient and safe.
Aligns garden tasks with workshop access, drainage, and noise constraints.
Creates consistent routines for cleaning, stacking, and equipment use.
Keeps the workshop productive while changes are rolled out.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current issues and approve target workshop zoning concept.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to list current pain points and react to first zoning sketch.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the main zones to include in the new layout (construction prep, PCB prep, garden tools, loading).
Confirm that A1 will be the single source of truth for the layout plan.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define shared storage, stacking rules, and tool usage process.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing draft storage rules and asking for comments from all roles.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the shared tool and storage rules in A3, including labelling and booking.
Lock in stacking and crane path rules from T7 for implementation.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on safety, cleaning routines, and incident logging.
threads_plan.trigger: Post with draft safety and cleaning checklist asking for zone‑specific tweaks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off the final version of the safety and cleaning checklist A2.
Confirm the format and usage of the daily progress and incident log A6.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock the phased implementation schedule and pilot test plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing the draft phasing sheet and asking for timing conflicts.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the implementation phasing and schedule in A4.
Agree on the duration and scope of the pilot test using temporary markings.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot feedback and confirm final layout and SOPs.
threads_plan.trigger: Post summarizing pilot results and proposing final tweaks to layout and SOPs.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm or adjust the agreed main zones based on pilot feedback.
Reconfirm safety and cleaning checklist after pilot adjustments.

channel_rituals: Daily quick async check-in: each role posts blockers and planned tasks for the day.
Twice-weekly layout sync: short thread to review progress against A4 and adjust tasks.
Weekly safety review: share any incidents from A6 and propose checklist updates.
Pilot period recap at end of week: summarize findings and update A7.
Final sign-off ritual: post walkthrough results using A8 and confirm project closure.
